concepts.anchor: Immediately after `## Braintree Orchestration`, before the existing Adyen-qualified paragraph
concepts.proposed_markdown: A collected 2026-09-16 overview defines PayPal Payment Orchestration as a Braintree-facing layer for connecting multiple PSPs, acquirers and value-added services through one integration, allowing merchants to route and manage transactions while retaining their existing client-side tokenization and SDK code. It requires authorization, capture, void and refund operations to go through Braintree to avoid reconciliation and synchronization problems from direct connector calls. This provider-level definition does not establish connector-specific capabilities or prerequisites, does not prove enablement, execution, settlement or funding, and does not make Orchestration a [[braintree-forward-api]] flow. [[source-braintree-orchestration-overview]]
warnings: Retain the existing Adyen-qualified flow, prerequisites, lifecycle and country-scope conflict as destination-specific facts rather than generalizing them to all orchestration connectors.
Do not copy the connector inventory into the concept hub or treat Braintree-hosted destination summaries as independent destination authority.
